answer: Recursive ZK-STARK reputation commitments anchored in a grove of validators yield succinct proofs that any forged identity would break hash-chain soundness. A zero-knowledge verifiable delay bound to staked collateral forces sequential work; deviation incurs slashing penalties, giving negative expected attack utility. The resulting protocol achieves a robust Nash equilibrium where rational agents abandon cloning, as the karst of incentives and the voyage of delay render Sybil creation infeasible.
